ns2:section.sectionText: A comprehensive understanding of hip-hop dance and culture through an embodied exploration of vernacular forms. Restricted to Dance majors. Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.This course begins with ballet basics; terminology, foundational movements, and ballet etiquette, with an intent to progress over the semester to take a full ballet class with work at a ballet barre and at the center of the room. This class will focus on training the body and muscles in turnout, ballet's relationship to classical music, and discussing ballet history and locality in comparison with current times. Recommended level: Beginning to intermediate
